file_purpose: Prompt-ready VDA PPF/PPA validation rules written in original project language from public process knowledge, not copied from the copyrighted VDA Band 2 text.
source_note: VDA Band 2 detailed requirements are copyrighted and must be licensed for production-grade compliance use.
This catalog provides an evidence-bound VDA-oriented starting point using publicly described PPF/PPA artifacts and common automotive approval controls.
how_to_use: Select the VDA submission artifact to validate.
Attach that artifact's evidence and evidence for related artifact checks.
Render the selected artifact rules compactly for the validation model.
The model must return one checkpoint result for every supplied rule_id.

global_prompt_contract.system_message: You are a VDA PPF/PPA validation agent. You validate one VDA submission artifact at a time. You must follow every supplied rule exactly, cite evidence, and return strict JSON only.

allowed_verdicts.FLAG: Evidence is present but nonconforming, incomplete, stale, inconsistent, or conflicts with another artifact.
allowed_verdicts.NOT_FOUND: Required evidence, a required field, or a required linked artifact is absent.

hard_rules: Do not bypass, merge, soften, or summarize any supplied rule.
Do not guess values that are not printed in evidence.
Do not use general VDA knowledge to fill missing evidence.
Do not mark missing evidence as PASS.
Do not confuse NOT_FOUND with FLAG.
For a cross-artifact rule, compare exact identifiers, revisions, dates, characteristics, sample counts, specifications, tolerances, limits, and result values when evidence contains them.
For a cross-artifact rule, return NOT_FOUND when the referenced artifact is required but absent.
For a cross-artifact rule, return PASS only when the compared details match or the rule explicitly allows the referenced artifact to be absent.
Do not output Approved or Rejected.
Do not skip any supplied rule_id.

evidence.quote: short exact quote from supplied evidence

checkpoint_results.reason: short rule-specific explanation with exact value(s) when present
checkpoint_results.recommended_action: what to fix when status is FLAG or NOT_FOUND; empty string otherwise

elements.applicability_rule: Required when the VDA PPF/PPA submission must prove conformity to a released product definition.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 01 - Design Record.
Apply every supplied rule. Do not skip or combine rules.
Use primary design-record evidence for artifact-specific checks.
Use related artifact evidence only when a rule names that related artifact.
Return strict JSON only.
watch_outs: Do not accept a filename as proof of part number, revision, release status, or specification.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a released design record, drawing, CAD-derived specification, or customer product specification for the submitted part. Verdict logic: PASS if the design record is present; NOT_FOUND if no design record evidence is supplied.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use only evidence chunks tagged to this artifact. Do not use the filename as the only evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate the part number on the design record itself. Verdict logic: PASS with the printed part number; NOT_FOUND if no part number is printed in the evidence.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the exact part-number text from the design record.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate the design revision, issue level, or release index on the design record. Verdict logic: PASS with the printed revision; NOT_FOUND if no revision or release identifier is present.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the exact revision or release text.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the design record contains product characteristics, dimensions, tolerances, material, or specification references that can drive sampling and inspection. Verdict logic: PASS if at least one controlled requirement set is visible; FLAG if the document is present but insufficient to define what must be inspected; NOT_FOUND if no controlled requirements are visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one representative controlled requirement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check whether special, safety, regulatory, or customer-marked characteristics are identified when they appear on the design record. Verdict logic: PASS if markings are present or the evidence clearly shows none; FLAG if markings appear ambiguous or not carried consistently; NOT_FOUND if the relevant drawing area is missing.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the characteristic marking or the statement showing none are present.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare the part number and revision on the design record against the PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if both match; FLAG if either value conflicts; NOT_FOUND if the warrant or comparable values are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 19 and cite the compared value from the primary or related evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare listed characteristics on the design record against Dimensional Results (9) or the Initial Sample Inspection Report (11). Verdict logic: PASS if inspected characteristics can be traced; FLAG if required characteristics are missing or unmatched; NOT_FOUND if no measurement evidence is supplied.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9 and 11 only for the traceability comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare material or performance specifications on the design record against Material and Functional Test Results (10). Verdict logic: PASS if every visible required specification has supporting test or certificate evidence; FLAG if a required specification is unsupported or conflicting; NOT_FOUND if no test evidence is supplied.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 10 for the comparison.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when the submitted part, drawing, process, material, tooling, source, or specification has an engineering or technical change relevant to PPF/PPA approval.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 02 - Engineering Change Documentation.
Do not assume a change exists when evidence does not show one.
If no change document is required by the submitted scope, rules may PASS only when evidence supports non-applicability.
watch_outs: A changed revision on a drawing without an authorized change record is a consistency risk.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate an engineering change, technical change, deviation, change notice, or customer authorization applicable to the submitted part. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if the package references a change but no change evidence is supplied; PASS if evidence clearly shows no change applies.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the change document title, number, or explicit no-change statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate the change identifier, issue number, or authorization number. Verdict logic: PASS with the printed identifier; NOT_FOUND if a change document is present but no identifier is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the exact change identifier.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate the change description or affected requirement. Verdict logic: PASS if the changed product/process/material/tooling/specification item is described; FLAG if the description is too vague to determine impact; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the affected item or change description.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate approval status, approver, approval date, or effective date for the change. Verdict logic: PASS if authorization timing is visible; FLAG if the change is pending, expired, or after the submitted sample build without explanation; NOT_FOUND if no approval timing is shown.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the approval status/date or effective date.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare the changed revision or affected requirement against the Design Record (1). Verdict logic: PASS if the design record reflects the authorized change; FLAG if the design record and change record conflict; NOT_FOUND if comparable values are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 1 for revision/requirement comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm affected inspection or test evidence reflects the change. Compare against Dimensional Results (9), Material and Functional Test Results (10), and ISIR (11). Verdict logic: PASS if the changed requirement is included in relevant results; FLAG if relevant evidence still reflects the old requirement; NOT_FOUND if the needed results are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 10, and 11 only as needed.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm process-related changes are reflected in Process Flow (5), Process FMEA (6), and Control Plan (7). Verdict logic: PASS if affected operations/controls are updated; FLAG if any related process artifact conflicts or omits the change; NOT_FOUND if required process artifacts are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 5, 6, and 7 for process impact comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare change identifiers or revision levels against the PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if the warrant reflects the same change/revision; FLAG if the warrant references a different change state; NOT_FOUND if comparable warrant evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 19 for warrant comparison.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when the customer requires technical approval, trial approval, deviation approval, customer release, or special release before or with PPF/PPA submission.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 03 - Customer Technical Approval.
Do not treat supplier self-approval as customer technical approval.
When the artifact is not applicable, require evidence supporting that non-applicability.
watch_outs: Temporary approvals or deviations must not be treated as unrestricted serial release.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer technical approval, trial approval, deviation approval, special release, or an explicit statement that customer technical approval is not required. Verdict logic: PASS if appropriate evidence is present; NOT_FOUND if required approval evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the customer approval title or non-applicability statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate the customer approval identifier, deviation number, or release reference. Verdict logic: PASS with the printed identifier; NOT_FOUND if approval evidence has no identifier.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the exact approval identifier.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate approval status and approval date or validity period. Verdict logic: PASS if current and clear; FLAG if expired, conditional, or pending; NOT_FOUND if no status/date/validity is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite status and timing evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Identify conditions, limitations, quantity limits, expiry dates, or actions attached to the approval. Verdict logic: PASS if no restrictions are stated or restrictions are clearly captured; FLAG if restrictions are present but unresolved; NOT_FOUND if the approval text is incomplete.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the condition text or explicit unrestricted statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare approved part number/revision against Design Record (1) and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if identifiers match; FLAG if they conflict; NOT_FOUND if comparable values are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 1 and 19 for comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: If approval is conditional or deviation-based, confirm related inspection/test evidence addresses the condition. Compare against Dimensional Results (9), Test Results (10), or ISIR (11). Verdict logic: PASS if condition evidence is addressed; FLAG if condition evidence is missing or contradictory; NOT_FOUND if related evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 10, and 11 only for stated approval conditions.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm customer approval requirements from Customer Specific Requirements (18) are satisfied. Verdict logic: PASS if required customer approval evidence is present and consistent; FLAG if a customer-required approval is incomplete; NOT_FOUND if CSR evidence is absent where needed.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 18 for required approval scope.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether the approval evidence is legible enough to support validation of customer, part, revision, status, and validity. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if partially unreadable; NOT_FOUND if the approval evidence cannot be read.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable field or describe the unreadable region from evidence.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when the supplier has design responsibility or customer scope requires design risk evidence.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 04 - Design FMEA.
Do not infer design risk controls from PFMEA or Control Plan.
If DFMEA is not applicable, require evidence showing design responsibility or customer scope.
watch_outs: DFMEA may be legitimately unavailable to the supplier when the customer owns design; the package still needs evidence of that responsibility split.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a DFMEA, design risk analysis, or documented statement that DFMEA is not applicable because the supplier does not own design responsibility. Verdict logic: PASS if valid evidence is present; NOT_FOUND if design risk evidence is required but absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the DFMEA title or non-applicability/design-responsibility statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate part number, revision, product family, or scope on the DFMEA. Verdict logic: PASS if the scope identifies the submitted product; FLAG if scope is ambiguous or mismatched; NOT_FOUND if scope is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the DFMEA scope identifier.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the DFMEA includes failure modes, effects, causes, prevention controls, detection controls, and action tracking or risk priority/action priority fields. Verdict logic: PASS if these core columns/fields are present; FLAG if important columns are missing; NOT_FOUND if no usable DFMEA table is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the header row or field list.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check that high-risk or high-priority design items have actions, owners, target dates, or documented acceptance. Verdict logic: PASS if high-risk items are addressed; FLAG if actions/owners/dates are missing; NOT_FOUND if risk ranking/action evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one high-risk item or action record.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare DFMEA part/revision/scope against Design Record (1). Verdict logic: PASS if aligned; FLAG if product or revision scope conflicts; NOT_FOUND if comparable evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 1 for comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm special or safety characteristics identified in DFMEA are carried into Process FMEA (6), Control Plan (7), and inspection evidence (9 or 11). Verdict logic: PASS if traceable; FLAG if a characteristic is missing downstream; NOT_FOUND if downstream artifacts are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 6, 7, 9, and 11 for traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm design-related test requirements from DFMEA are reflected in Material and Functional Test Results (10). Verdict logic: PASS if tests cover identified design risks; FLAG if required tests are missing; NOT_FOUND if test evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 10 for test coverage.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether the DFMEA evidence is legible and complete enough to validate risk rows and actions. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if important rows/columns are cut off or unreadable; NOT_FOUND if DFMEA content cannot be read.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable row/field or identify the missing unreadable area.

elements.applicability_rule: Required for VDA PPF/PPA submissions that must demonstrate the intended serial production process.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 05 - Process Flow Diagram.
Use process flow evidence for sequence checks.
Do not infer process steps from file names or unrelated documents.
watch_outs: The process flow is the backbone for PFMEA and Control Plan traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a process flow diagram, process sequence, routing, or process flow chart for the submitted product. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the flow title or sequence header.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the flow identifies operation numbers, operation names, sequence arrows, or an ordered step list. Verdict logic: PASS if sequence is clear; FLAG if steps are present but order is unclear; NOT_FOUND if no sequence details are visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one operation number/name or sequence line.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the flow includes production, inspection, rework/repair when applicable, handling/storage, and packaging/shipping where visible in the process. Verdict logic: PASS if the flow covers the full serial path; FLAG if obvious required stages are missing; NOT_FOUND if content is too sparse to assess.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite visible included or missing stages.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate product/process scope, part number, revision, plant, line, or process owner. Verdict logic: PASS if the flow can be tied to the submitted product/process; FLAG if scope is ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if no scope identifier is present.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the scope identifier.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare process-flow operations against Process FMEA (6). Verdict logic: PASS if operations are traceable; FLAG if PFMEA omits or adds unexplained operations; NOT_FOUND if PFMEA is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 6 for operation traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare process-flow operations against Control Plan (7). Verdict logic: PASS if control-plan operations align with the flow; FLAG if controls are missing for process steps; NOT_FOUND if Control Plan is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 7 for control traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare product/process scope against PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if scope identifiers align; FLAG if part/process/revision conflicts; NOT_FOUND if comparable warrant evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 19 for scope comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether the flow is legible and complete enough to support traceability. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if parts of the flow are unreadable or truncated; NOT_FOUND if no readable flow is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable operation or describe missing/unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required to show process risks and controls for the submitted serial production process.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 06 - Process FMEA.
Do not accept a Control Plan as a substitute for PFMEA.
Check traceability to process flow and controls.
watch_outs: PFMEA must follow the process sequence and drive control plan content.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a PFMEA or process risk analysis for the submitted part/process. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the PFMEA title or header.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate product/process scope, part number, revision, process family, or plant/line identifier. Verdict logic: PASS if the PFMEA scope matches the submission; FLAG if scope is ambiguous or conflicting; NOT_FOUND if scope is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the scope identifier.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm PFMEA rows include process step/function, failure mode, failure effect, cause, prevention control, detection control, risk ranking or action priority, and action tracking. Verdict logic: PASS if core fields are visible; FLAG if important fields are missing; NOT_FOUND if no usable PFMEA rows are visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the header row or a representative row.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check that high-risk/high-priority process items have actions, owners, due dates, status, or documented acceptance. Verdict logic: PASS if addressed; FLAG if action evidence is incomplete; NOT_FOUND if risk/action evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one high-risk action or missing action field.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare PFMEA process steps against Process Flow Diagram (5). Verdict logic: PASS if steps align; FLAG if PFMEA omits or adds unexplained steps; NOT_FOUND if flow evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 5 for process step comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare PFMEA controls and characteristics against Control Plan (7). Verdict logic: PASS if prevention/detection controls and special characteristics are carried into controls; FLAG if controls are missing or inconsistent; NOT_FOUND if Control Plan is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 7 for control comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm PFMEA special or critical characteristics are represented in Dimensional Results (9), ISIR (11), or Initial Process Capability (12) where measurable. Verdict logic: PASS if traceable; FLAG if measurable critical characteristics lack evidence; NOT_FOUND if measurement/capability artifacts are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 11, and 12 for evidence coverage.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether PFMEA evidence is legible and complete enough to validate risk rows. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if relevant rows or columns are unreadable; NOT_FOUND if PFMEA content cannot be read.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable row/header or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required to define serial production controls for product and process characteristics.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 07 - Control Plan.
Do not accept generic inspection instructions unless tied to the submitted product/process.
Check linkage to process flow, PFMEA, measurement systems, and reaction plans.
watch_outs: Control plans often look complete while missing reaction plans, frequencies, or gauge references.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a control plan, production control plan, inspection plan, or equivalent control document for the submitted process. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the control-plan title or header.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate part number, revision, product/process family, plant, line, or control-plan revision. Verdict logic: PASS if scope is clear; FLAG if scope conflicts or is ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if no scope identifier is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the scope identifier.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the plan lists product/process characteristics, specifications/tolerances, control methods, gauges or equipment, sample size, frequency, responsibility, and reaction plan. Verdict logic: PASS if core fields are present; FLAG if important fields are missing; NOT_FOUND if no usable control table is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the header row or representative control row.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check that every listed special, safety, regulatory, or customer characteristic has an explicit control method and reaction plan. Verdict logic: PASS if all visible marked characteristics are controlled; FLAG if any marked characteristic lacks control/reaction evidence; NOT_FOUND if characteristic/control evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one marked characteristic and its control or missing control.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare control-plan operations against Process Flow Diagram (5). Verdict logic: PASS if controls align to process steps; FLAG if steps lack controls or controls do not trace to the flow; NOT_FOUND if flow evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 5 for operation traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare control-plan characteristics and controls against PFMEA (6). Verdict logic: PASS if PFMEA risks and controls are represented; FLAG if important PFMEA controls/characteristics are missing; NOT_FOUND if PFMEA evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 6 for risk/control traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm gauges or measurement systems named in the control plan have supporting Measurement System Analysis (8) or calibration evidence. Verdict logic: PASS if referenced systems are supported; FLAG if support is incomplete; NOT_FOUND if MSA/calibration evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 8 for measurement-system support.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm controlled characteristics are represented in Dimensional Results (9), Test Results (10), ISIR (11), or Capability Studies (12) as applicable. Verdict logic: PASS if evidence covers the controlled characteristics; FLAG if required result evidence is missing; NOT_FOUND if related result evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 10, 11, and 12 for evidence coverage.

elements.applicability_rule: Required for measurement systems used to make reported product/process approval decisions.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 08 - Measurement System Analysis.
Do not mark a gauge acceptable unless acceptance evidence is printed.
Check linkage to reported characteristics and control-plan gauges.
watch_outs: Calibration alone does not prove measurement-system suitability for the reported characteristic.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate MSA evidence, gauge R&R, bias, linearity, stability, capability, or documented measurement-system suitability evidence. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if no MSA/suitability evidence is supplied.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the MSA study title or method.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate gauge/equipment identifier, measurement method, characteristic, and part/process scope. Verdict logic: PASS if study scope is clear; FLAG if scope is ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if scope details are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite gauge id, method, or characteristic scope.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate study design details such as appraisers/operators, trials, parts, samples, date, and method. Verdict logic: PASS if study design is documented; FLAG if materially incomplete; NOT_FOUND if design details are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the study design details.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate numeric results and acceptance decision or threshold. Verdict logic: PASS if result meets the stated threshold; FLAG if result fails, is conditional, or threshold is missing; NOT_FOUND if numeric result is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the result and threshold/decision.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm calibration status or equipment validity is current for the study or measurement period. Verdict logic: PASS if valid calibration/equipment status is visible; FLAG if expired or out of tolerance; NOT_FOUND if calibration/status evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite calibration date/status or equipment validity.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare MSA equipment/characteristics against the Control Plan (7). Verdict logic: PASS if control-plan gauges or methods are supported by MSA evidence; FLAG if a referenced gauge lacks support; NOT_FOUND if control-plan or MSA comparable evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 7 for gauge/characteristic comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm gauges used in Dimensional Results (9), ISIR (11), or Capability Studies (12) are covered by MSA where evidence identifies the gauge. Verdict logic: PASS if covered; FLAG if a named gauge is unsupported; NOT_FOUND if measurement evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 11, and 12 for named gauges.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether the MSA evidence is legible and complete enough to validate method, scope, results, and decision. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if result tables are partially unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable MSA content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable result or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required to prove product dimensions and measurable characteristics meet released requirements for submitted samples.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 09 - Dimensional Results.
Do not accept pass/fail summaries without traceable measured values when the rule asks for values.
Compare directly to design-record requirements.
watch_outs: Every measured result must trace to a characteristic, specification, sample, and drawing/revision.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate dimensional results, measurement report, balloon report, or inspection report for the submitted samples. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the report title or table header.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate part number, drawing number, drawing revision, sample identification, and measurement date or report date. Verdict logic: PASS if scope is clear; FLAG if scope conflicts or is ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if scope fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the scope fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm results list characteristic numbers or balloon numbers, nominal/specification, tolerance/limits, actual measured values, and pass/fail or OK/NOK judgment. Verdict logic: PASS if these fields are present; FLAG if important fields are missing; NOT_FOUND if no usable results table is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one result row or header.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check whether any visible measured result is outside tolerance or marked not OK. Verdict logic: PASS if all visible results are within limits/OK; FLAG if any result is out of tolerance, not OK, or missing disposition; NOT_FOUND if actual values are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the result value and limit or disposition.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare dimensional characteristics against the Design Record (1). Verdict logic: PASS if measured characteristics trace to design requirements; FLAG if design requirements are omitted or unmatched; NOT_FOUND if design record is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 1 for characteristic traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare dimensional result scope against ISIR (11) and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if part/revision/sample scope aligns; FLAG if scope conflicts; NOT_FOUND if related scope evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 11 and 19 for scope comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm measurement equipment named in dimensional results is supported by MSA (8) or calibration evidence. Verdict logic: PASS if supported; FLAG if named equipment lacks support; NOT_FOUND if no equipment or MSA evidence is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 8 for equipment support.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether dimensional results are legible and complete enough to validate all listed characteristics. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if rows/values are cut off or unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable results are available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable result row or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when drawings, specifications, customer scope, or the product type require material, functional, performance, durability, surface, or regulatory tests.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 10 - Material and Functional Test Results.
Do not accept certificate presence alone when values or conformance statements are required.
Trace tests to specifications and submitted part scope.
watch_outs: Material certificates and performance tests must match the submitted part, material, revision, and specification.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate material certificates, material test reports, functional test reports, performance reports, durability reports, or specification test results. Verdict logic: PASS if relevant evidence is present; NOT_FOUND if required tests are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the report/certificate title.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate part number, material grade/specification, batch/lot/heat number, drawing revision, test date, and supplier/laboratory identity where applicable. Verdict logic: PASS if scope is clear; FLAG if scope conflicts or is ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if scope fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the scope fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the report shows test method, requirement/specification limit, actual result, and pass/fail or conformance statement. Verdict logic: PASS if complete; FLAG if values fail or required fields are incomplete; NOT_FOUND if result evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite one test result with requirement and value.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check whether any visible material or functional result fails, is out of limit, or is conditionally accepted. Verdict logic: PASS if all visible results conform; FLAG if any fail/conditional/out-of-limit result appears; NOT_FOUND if conformance evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the failed/accepted result or conforming result.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare material and test specifications against Design Record (1). Verdict logic: PASS if required specifications are tested; FLAG if a design-required test/specification is missing or conflicting; NOT_FOUND if design record evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 1 for specification traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm laboratory evidence supports tests performed by internal or external labs. Compare against Qualified Laboratory Documentation (13). Verdict logic: PASS if lab qualification covers the test scope; FLAG if qualification is expired or scope mismatch; NOT_FOUND if lab qualification evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 13 for lab qualification.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare test scope and conformance status against ISIR (11) and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if summaries align; FLAG if ISIR/warrant claims all requirements met while tests fail or are missing; NOT_FOUND if related summaries are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 11 and 19 for summary comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether test reports/certificates are legible and complete enough to validate requirements, values, and disposition. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if values/specifications are unreadable or truncated; NOT_FOUND if no readable test content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite a readable result or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required as the VDA-specific initial sample inspection summary connecting sampled parts, measured results, and submission disposition.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 11 - Initial Sample Inspection Report.
Treat ISIR/EMPB as a distinct artifact, not merely a dimensional-results table.
Check that the ISIR summarizes the same part, revision, samples, and results as related evidence.
watch_outs: The ISIR may summarize many result artifacts; do not let summary wording override failed supporting evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate an Initial Sample Inspection Report, ISIR, EMPB, first article report, or initial sample summary for the submitted part. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the ISIR/EMPB title or header.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer, supplier, part number, drawing number, revision, sample quantity, sample date, and submission reason where present. Verdict logic: PASS if core scope is clear; FLAG if fields conflict or are incomplete; NOT_FOUND if core scope fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the ISIR scope fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the ISIR includes measured characteristics or references to measurement/result attachments. Verdict logic: PASS if measurements or traceable attachments are present; FLAG if the report only states pass/fail without traceable result basis; NOT_FOUND if measurement/result summary is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the measurement summary or attachment reference.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate final sample/result disposition, conformity statement, deviations, or open issues. Verdict logic: PASS if disposition is clear and no unresolved issues are visible; FLAG if nonconformance/deviation/open issue is stated; NOT_FOUND if disposition is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the disposition or issue statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate responsible supplier sign-off, date, or approval/review field. Verdict logic: PASS if signed or otherwise formally reviewed; FLAG if signature/date is missing while the form requires it; NOT_FOUND if no sign-off/review evidence is present.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the sign-off or review field.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare ISIR part number and revision against Design Record (1) and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if aligned; FLAG if any conflict; NOT_FOUND if comparable values are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 1 and 19 for comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare ISIR summarized results against Dimensional Results (9), Test Results (10), and Capability Studies (12). Verdict logic: PASS if supporting evidence matches the ISIR disposition; FLAG if the ISIR reports conformance while supporting evidence is missing/failing/conflicting; NOT_FOUND if supporting evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 10, and 12 for result comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm sample quantity and sample identity align with Sample Production Parts (15). Verdict logic: PASS if sample evidence matches the ISIR; FLAG if quantities/identities conflict; NOT_FOUND if sample evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 15 for sample traceability.

elements.applicability_rule: Required for characteristics where customer scope, design risk, process risk, or control planning requires capability/stability evidence.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 12 - Initial Process Capability.
Do not invent thresholds. Use printed customer or report thresholds only.
Check stability, sample basis, and linkage to controlled characteristics.
watch_outs: A high capability index is not enough if the study uses the wrong characteristic, sample, or process state.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate initial process capability, short-term capability, SPC, control chart, or stability evidence for relevant characteristics. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if required capability evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the capability study title or characteristic.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate characteristic name/number, part number, process operation, sample size, time period, and study date. Verdict logic: PASS if study scope is clear; FLAG if scope is ambiguous or incomplete; NOT_FOUND if scope details are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the study scope details.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate capability or stability metrics such as Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk, control limits, trend/stability assessment, or stated customer metric. Verdict logic: PASS if metrics meet printed requirements; FLAG if metrics fail or no requirement is stated; NOT_FOUND if metrics are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite metric value and threshold/decision.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check whether out-of-control signals, non-normal assumptions, unstable trends, or special causes are identified and addressed. Verdict logic: PASS if stable or issues are documented with actions; FLAG if instability is visible without action; NOT_FOUND if stability evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite stability statement, chart signal, or action.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare capability characteristics against Control Plan (7), PFMEA (6), and Customer Specific Requirements (18). Verdict logic: PASS if required characteristics are covered; FLAG if required capability evidence is missing; NOT_FOUND if related scope evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 6, 7, and 18 for required capability scope.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm measurement systems used for capability study are supported by MSA (8). Verdict logic: PASS if supported; FLAG if unsupported or unsuitable; NOT_FOUND if MSA evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 8 for measurement-system support.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare capability sample/process scope against ISIR (11), Sample Production Parts (15), and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if the study belongs to the submitted sample/process; FLAG if scope conflicts; NOT_FOUND if related evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 11, 15, and 19 for scope comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether capability evidence is legible and complete enough to validate sample basis, metric, threshold, and decision. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if important charts/values are unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable capability content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable metric or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when material, functional, calibration, or other test evidence is produced by a laboratory whose qualification must be demonstrated.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 13 - Qualified Laboratory Documentation.
Do not treat a lab name alone as qualification evidence.
Check validity dates and test-method scope.
watch_outs: A laboratory certificate must cover the test methods actually used.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate laboratory accreditation, qualification certificate, internal lab approval, customer lab approval, or scope document. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if lab qualification evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the certificate or qualification title.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate laboratory name, accreditation/qualification body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, and approval status. Verdict logic: PASS if current and complete; FLAG if expired/pending/incomplete; NOT_FOUND if these fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite certificate number/status/date.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the qualification scope includes the test methods, materials, measurements, or calibrations used in the submission. Verdict logic: PASS if scope covers submitted tests; FLAG if scope mismatch or insufficient scope; NOT_FOUND if scope is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite relevant scope text.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Check if the lab qualification was valid on the test date. Verdict logic: PASS if valid on the test date; FLAG if expired before or issued after the test without explanation; NOT_FOUND if dates are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite certificate date and test date where available.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare lab identity and test method against Material and Functional Test Results (10). Verdict logic: PASS if lab and method are covered; FLAG if mismatch; NOT_FOUND if test evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 10 for lab/test comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare calibration or measurement-method qualification against MSA (8) and Checking Aids (17) where lab evidence supports measurement equipment. Verdict logic: PASS if consistent; FLAG if unsupported; NOT_FOUND if related evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 8 and 17 only when relevant.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm Customer Specific Requirements (18) for laboratory accreditation or customer-approved lab are satisfied. Verdict logic: PASS if satisfied; FLAG if a required accreditation/approval is missing or wrong; NOT_FOUND if CSR evidence is absent where needed.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 18 for customer lab requirements.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether lab qualification evidence is legible and complete enough to validate lab identity, scope, status, and dates. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if scope/date/status is unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable lab qualification content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable certificate/scope text or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required for parts with appearance, color, grain, gloss, texture, visible surface, master sample, or customer appearance requirements.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 14 - Appearance Approval.
Do not require appearance approval when evidence clearly shows the product is not appearance-relevant and no customer scope requires it.
Do not accept an unsigned appearance form if the form requires customer/supplier sign-off.
watch_outs: Appearance approval may be conditional on specific color, grain, tooling, or master sample conditions.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate appearance approval, appearance inspection, surface approval, color approval, AAI, or evidence that appearance approval is not applicable. Verdict logic: PASS if appropriate evidence is present; NOT_FOUND if required appearance evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the appearance form title or non-applicability statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate part number, color/material/finish/texture identifier, drawing revision, sample identity, and appearance requirement. Verdict logic: PASS if scope is clear; FLAG if scope conflicts or is incomplete; NOT_FOUND if scope fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite appearance scope fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate inspection/disposition result and approval status. Verdict logic: PASS if appearance is accepted or not applicable; FLAG if rejected, conditional, open, or missing disposition; NOT_FOUND if status is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite approval/disposition status.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer or authorized approver signature/date where required by the form or customer scope. Verdict logic: PASS if required sign-off is present; FLAG if required sign-off/date is missing; NOT_FOUND if sign-off section is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite sign-off/date or required missing field.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare appearance requirements against Design Record (1) and Customer Specific Requirements (18). Verdict logic: PASS if appearance evidence covers required surfaces/finishes/colors; FLAG if required appearance items are missing; NOT_FOUND if related requirements are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 1 and 18 for appearance requirement scope.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare approved appearance sample identity against Sample Production Parts (15) and Reference Sample (16). Verdict logic: PASS if sample identity aligns; FLAG if sample mismatch or missing retained reference; NOT_FOUND if related sample evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 15 and 16 for sample comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm appearance approval status is consistent with ISIR (11) and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if summaries match; FLAG if the warrant/ISIR claims complete conformity while appearance is open or failed; NOT_FOUND if related summary evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 11 and 19 for status comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether appearance evidence is legible and complete enough to validate product scope, requirement, result, and approval. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if important fields are unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable appearance content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable appearance evidence or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required to show that initial samples came from the intended production tooling, process, material, and lot where required by the PPF/PPA scope.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 15 - Sample Production Parts.
Do not accept sample photos or labels unless they identify the submitted part/sample scope.
Check production process origin and traceability.
watch_outs: Samples built outside the intended serial process need clear authorization or they cannot prove serial conformity.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate evidence of sample production parts, initial samples, sample labels, sample shipment, sample photos, or sample inventory records. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if no sample-part evidence is supplied.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the sample evidence title, label, or photo caption.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate part number, revision, sample quantity, sample identifiers, lot/batch/date, and production location/line where available. Verdict logic: PASS if traceability is clear; FLAG if traceability is incomplete or conflicting; NOT_FOUND if sample identifiers are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite sample traceability fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm samples are identified as produced from intended serial tooling/process/material or an authorized alternate. Verdict logic: PASS if serial origin or authorized alternate is shown; FLAG if origin is prototype/non-serial/unclear; NOT_FOUND if origin evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite serial process/tooling/material origin evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm sample quantity meets the submitted customer scope or is at least explicitly documented. Verdict logic: PASS if quantity is documented and consistent with scope; FLAG if quantity is below stated requirement or inconsistent; NOT_FOUND if quantity is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite sample quantity and requirement if present.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare sample identity and quantity against ISIR (11), Dimensional Results (9), and Test Results (10). Verdict logic: PASS if the same samples or traceable lots are used; FLAG if result evidence uses different or unexplained samples; NOT_FOUND if result evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9, 10, and 11 for sample traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare sample-production process origin against Process Flow (5) and Control Plan (7). Verdict logic: PASS if samples come from the intended controlled process; FLAG if origin conflicts or controls are not represented; NOT_FOUND if process evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 5 and 7 for process origin comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare sample traceability against PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if sample scope aligns; FLAG if sample quantity/origin conflicts; NOT_FOUND if warrant evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 19 for sample-scope comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether sample evidence is legible and complete enough to prove identity, quantity, origin, and traceability. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if label/photo/record is ambiguous or unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable sample evidence is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable sample evidence or identify ambiguity.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when the customer or supplier retains a reference/master sample for comparison, subjective inspection, appearance, fit, function, or training.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 16 - Reference Sample.
Do not assume a reference sample exists unless evidence identifies it.
Check retention location, identity, and approval status.
watch_outs: Reference samples must be traceable to the approved sample state, not just photographed parts.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a reference sample, master sample, retained sample, boundary sample, or explicit statement that no reference sample is required. Verdict logic: PASS if appropriate evidence is present; NOT_FOUND if required reference-sample evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite reference-sample title, id, or non-applicability statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate sample id, part number, revision, retention location, owner, date, and validity/retention period where applicable. Verdict logic: PASS if traceability and retention are clear; FLAG if incomplete; NOT_FOUND if traceability fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite sample id/location/owner/date fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm customer/supplier sign-off or approval evidence is present when required by the form or customer scope. Verdict logic: PASS if required approval is present or not required; FLAG if required approval is missing; NOT_FOUND if approval section is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite approval/signature or non-required statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Identify reference-sample purpose such as visual comparison, fit/function, noise, appearance, operator training, or boundary condition. Verdict logic: PASS if purpose is clear; FLAG if retained sample purpose is ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if purpose is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the stated reference-sample purpose.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare reference sample identity against Sample Production Parts (15) and ISIR (11). Verdict logic: PASS if identities align; FLAG if the reference sample does not trace to submitted samples; NOT_FOUND if related sample evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 11 and 15 for sample traceability.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: If reference sample is used for appearance, compare against Appearance Approval (14). Verdict logic: PASS if appearance sample identity/status aligns; FLAG if mismatch; PASS if appearance is not applicable and evidence supports that; NOT_FOUND if appearance evidence is needed but absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 14 when appearance-related.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare reference-sample requirement against Customer Specific Requirements (18). Verdict logic: PASS if customer requirement is met or no reference sample is required; FLAG if a required retained sample is missing/incomplete; NOT_FOUND if CSR evidence is absent where needed.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 18 for customer reference-sample requirements.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether reference-sample evidence is legible and complete enough to validate identity, location, approval, and purpose. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if important fields are unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable reference-sample content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable sample evidence or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required when special gauges, checking fixtures, templates, test stands, or other checking aids are used for product/process approval decisions.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 17 - Checking Aids.
Do not accept a photo alone unless it identifies the checking aid and calibration/approval context.
Trace checking aids to control-plan and measurement evidence.
watch_outs: Checking aids must be suitable, identified, and valid for the characteristics they verify.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate checking-aid, fixture, special gauge, test stand, template, or explicit statement that no special checking aid is used. Verdict logic: PASS if appropriate evidence is present; NOT_FOUND if required checking-aid evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite checking-aid title/id or no-aid statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate checking-aid identifier, revision, drawing/specification, owner/location, and applicable characteristic or operation. Verdict logic: PASS if traceability is clear; FLAG if incomplete/ambiguous; NOT_FOUND if identity/scope is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite aid id/revision/scope fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate calibration, verification, dimensional certification, or acceptance evidence for the checking aid. Verdict logic: PASS if valid; FLAG if expired/out-of-tolerance/incomplete; NOT_FOUND if validity evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite calibration/verification status and date.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm the checking aid has usage instructions, acceptance criteria, or inspection method where needed. Verdict logic: PASS if method/criteria are documented; FLAG if usage is unclear; NOT_FOUND if method/criteria are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite method or acceptance criteria.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare checking aids against Control Plan (7). Verdict logic: PASS if control-plan gauges/fixtures match checking-aid evidence; FLAG if a listed aid lacks support or an aid is used without control-plan reference; NOT_FOUND if control-plan evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 7 for gauge/fixture comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm checking aids used in Dimensional Results (9) or ISIR (11) are identified and valid. Verdict logic: PASS if supported; FLAG if named aids are unsupported or invalid; NOT_FOUND if related measurement evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 9 and 11 for usage comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare checking-aid requirements against Customer Specific Requirements (18). Verdict logic: PASS if required aids are documented; FLAG if customer-required aid evidence is missing/incomplete; NOT_FOUND if CSR evidence is absent where needed.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 18 for checking-aid requirements.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether checking-aid evidence is legible and complete enough to validate identity, scope, validity, and use. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if important fields are unreadable; NOT_FOUND if no readable checking-aid content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable checking-aid evidence or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required to capture customer-specific VDA PPF/PPA scope, forms, thresholds, submission content, approval rules, and deviations from generic expectations.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 18 - Customer Specific Requirements.
Customer-specific requirements govern when they conflict with generic assumptions.
Do not invent customer requirements from normal practice.
watch_outs: VDA PPF/PPA scope may be customer-agreed; the system must not assume all artifacts are always submitted.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer-specific requirements, submission-scope agreement, customer form list, portal requirements, sampling scope, or an explicit statement that no additional customer-specific requirements apply. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if no CSR/scope evidence is supplied.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite customer requirement or no-additional-requirements statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer name, program/part scope, applicable standard/version, submission scope, required artifacts, or customer portal/form references. Verdict logic: PASS if scope is clear; FLAG if scope is ambiguous or incomplete; NOT_FOUND if scope fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite customer scope fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer thresholds or special rules for capability, MSA, sample quantity, test methods, appearance, lab approval, or retention. Verdict logic: PASS if thresholds/rules are captured or explicitly none; FLAG if required thresholds are missing or contradicted; NOT_FOUND if requirement evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the customer threshold/rule or explicit none statement.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer-required approval route, approver, portal workflow, or disposition method. Verdict logic: PASS if approval route is defined or not required; FLAG if required approval path is incomplete; NOT_FOUND if approval route evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite approval-route evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare customer-required artifact scope against present artifacts and PPF Submission Warrant (19). Verdict logic: PASS if required artifacts/scope are reflected; FLAG if the warrant or package omits required content; NOT_FOUND if warrant evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 19 for scope comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm customer thresholds are applied in MSA (8), Capability (12), Dimensional Results (9), and Test Results (10) where relevant. Verdict logic: PASS if customer values govern; FLAG if generic/internal values are used instead or thresholds are not applied; NOT_FOUND if related evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 8, 9, 10, and 12 for threshold application.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Confirm customer-specific form/signature/approval requirements are reflected in ISIR (11), Appearance Approval (14), Reference Sample (16), and Customer Technical Approval (3) as applicable. Verdict logic: PASS if reflected; FLAG if required customer fields/signatures are missing; NOT_FOUND if related evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 3, 11, 14, and 16 as applicable.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Assess whether customer-specific requirement evidence is legible and complete enough to validate scope, thresholds, artifacts, and approval route. Verdict logic: PASS if readable; FLAG if important requirement text is unreadable or incomplete; NOT_FOUND if no readable CSR content is available.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite readable CSR evidence or identify unreadable content.

elements.applicability_rule: Required as the VDA PPF/PPA cover document summarizing submission identity, reason, scope, sample/result status, and requested/customer disposition.
prompt_instructions: Validate only VDA artifact 19 - PPF Submission Warrant.
Treat this as the package summary; do not let it override failed supporting evidence.
Do not output Approved or Rejected.
watch_outs: A warrant claiming all requirements are met must be flagged if any supporting artifact shows failures or missing evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate a PPF/PPA submission warrant, PSW, Teilevorlagebestaetigung, submission cover sheet, or equivalent package summary. Verdict logic: PASS if present; NOT_FOUND if absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite the warrant/cover sheet title.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate customer, supplier, part number, part name, drawing number, revision, submission date, and production site where present. Verdict logic: PASS if core identity is clear; FLAG if identity conflicts or is incomplete; NOT_FOUND if core identity fields are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite warrant identity fields.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate reason for submission, trigger, change reason, new part reason, requalification, tooling/process change, or customer request. Verdict logic: PASS if reason is stated; FLAG if reason conflicts with change evidence; NOT_FOUND if no reason is visible.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite reason-for-submission text.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate submitted scope, artifact list, sample quantity, submission stage, requested disposition, or customer-agreed content. Verdict logic: PASS if scope is clear; FLAG if scope is incomplete or conflicts with CSR; NOT_FOUND if submission scope is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite submission-scope evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Locate supplier declaration, responsible person, signature/date, or formal review statement. Verdict logic: PASS if formal supplier sign-off is present; FLAG if required sign-off/date is missing; NOT_FOUND if no declaration/sign-off evidence is present.
rules.evidence_instruction: Cite sign-off/declaration evidence.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare warrant part number and revision against Design Record (1), ISIR (11), Dimensional Results (9), and Test Results (10). Verdict logic: PASS if core identity aligns; FLAG if any supporting artifact conflicts; NOT_FOUND if supporting evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 1, 9, 10, and 11 for identity comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare warrant claim that requirements are met against Dimensional Results (9), Test Results (10), ISIR (11), Capability (12), Appearance Approval (14), and Customer Technical Approval (3). Verdict logic: PASS if supporting artifacts show conforming or applicable status; FLAG if any required artifact shows failure, open issue, conditional release, or missing result; NOT_FOUND if supporting artifacts are absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifacts 3, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 14 for package-status comparison.

rules.agent_instruction: Task: Compare warrant submission scope against Customer Specific Requirements (18). Verdict logic: PASS if customer-required scope is reflected; FLAG if customer-required artifacts, forms, signatures, thresholds, or approvals are missing from the warrant/package; NOT_FOUND if CSR evidence is absent.
rules.evidence_instruction: Use related artifact 18 for scope comparison.
